summary: Most design values trace to TEV-961 Case 6 (925 C ROT): 900 C and 466 C helium, 176.8 MWth, 17.3 MWe, 5.7 MWe purge recovery, 39.7%, 1,927 and 142 short ton/d. 210 MWth, 11.6 MWe, 206.0 MWth, 30 wt% MEA and 85% availability are project values, not INL's. The main finding is that 34.0 MMSCFD depends on recycling PSA reject gas, whose Aspen stream is named PURGE. INL's Cases 2 to 5 and its no-recycle case put zero-recycle gas at about 44.5 MMSCFD. Excluding the 5.7 MWe while keeping 34.0 and 130 MMSCFD is therefore not a balanced flowsheet: the exclusion avoids about S$8M/y of electricity but keeps about S$54M/y of gas savings that this equipment produces (my calculation). The 5.7 MWe is probably mostly recycle compression, inferred because the local TEV-961 PDF stops at A-59. It has no Case 6 calculator or stream sheets, and the electronic stream appendices are not local. Complete Case 6 needs 220.4 MWth at 39.7%; Case 5 needs 205.8 MWth with nothing excluded. TEV-953 and TEV-961 contain no economic data and no availability factor.

conflicts.detail: Slide 3 excludes PSA tail gas and slide 6 excludes 5.7 MWe, yet slide 6 and final_v1_7 keep 34.0 MMSCFD and 130 MMSCFD, which INL reaches only through total fuel gas recycle.
conflicts.resolution: Keep the recycle in the balance with its electricity, or use a no-recycle basis of about 44.5 MMSCFD.

conflicts.detail: Slide 6 uses 34.0 (Case 6). Slide 25 labels 43.5 as HTGR-assisted, but that is the 700 C helium case with fired Stage 2. Avoided gas is 18.5 against 9.0 MMSCFD, about S$94.8M/y against S$46.1M/y.
conflicts.resolution: Use one case throughout and label it.

conflicts.detail: Slide 6, final_v1_7 and amine_spec use 210 MWth. report_latest and the 31 October draft use 230 MWth from a 220.38 MWth requirement with full 17.3 MWe.
conflicts.resolution: Follows from the purge decision; 210 fits only with the exclusion or with Case 5.

conflicts.detail: Deck and 31 October draft use 39.7% from TEV-961. final_v1_7 uses 47% on 25.1 MWth. INL/EXT-11-21537 Table 4 gives 47.5% at 900 C on a 66% of Carnot basis. TEV-981 is not local.
conflicts.resolution: Use one value and state the basis; 39.7% is the TEV-961 Case 6 row.

conflicts.detail: final_v1_7 and amine_spec apply 90% to 2,069 short ton/d (1,862). INL shifted syngas holds 1,927/0.99 = 1,946, so 90% per pass is 1,752. Difference about 31,000 t/y captured; emitted 317 against 207 short ton/d.
conflicts.resolution: Use the syngas CO2 basis, or model the recycle loop explicitly.

conflicts.detail: final_v1_7 says 93.1% is not a plant-wide capture fraction. Captured plus emitted closes to 99.6% of feed carbon, so it is effectively that ratio. INL's stated 99% is across Selexol.
final_v1_7 Table A1 and amine_spec give 31.7 bar. That equals 460 psia, the NG and recycle compressor discharge. Reformer outlet is 439 psia = 30.3 bar (Cases 2 and 5).
conflicts.resolution: Correct to 30.3 bar and note Case 6 pressure is not local.

conflicts.detail: amine_spec uses 35 C and 21 bar from Chen and Ahn 2021. INL delivers 40 C and 26.8 bar, so CO2 partial pressure is 4.7 to 5.1 bar against 3.8 bar.
conflicts.resolution: Align the MEA simulation with the flowsheet basis or justify the difference.

conflicts.detail: 31 October Table A1 calls it reformer process heat demand. It is total process heat including feed, steam and air preheat; in Case 5 the reformer is 71% of the total.
final_v1_7 calls about 11 MWe the load for capture and compression. The 11.6 MWe also holds reforming, steam, cooling and water; Selexol plus CO2 compression is 8.5 MWe, and MEA loads are not in it.
TEV-961 favours 925 C for single-stage reforming and heat-only fit. INL/EXT-11-21537 later names 875 C optimum. Case 5 uses 34.5 MMSCFD, emits 126 against 142 short ton/d, but keeps a fired stage.
conflicts.resolution: Cite both; see the reference-case decision.

conflicts.detail: Aspen labels show 1,015 psia (7.0 MPa); TEV-961 Table 1 says 9.1 MPa. INL/EXT-11-21537 uses 7 MPa.
conflicts.resolution: Use 7.0 MPa for the flowsheet and note the discrepancy.

decisions.question: How should PSA reject recycle and the 5.7 MWe be treated?
decisions.why: This sets natural gas, H2 output, emissions and the reactor size. Excluding it while keeping 34.0 MMSCFD is inconsistent, and about S$54M/y of gas is at stake.
decisions.default: Keep Case 6 intact: show the recycle stream crossing the boundary, count 17.3 MWe, and remove the exclusion row from slide 6.
options: Keep recycle and 17.3 MWe with 34.0 MMSCFD
Declare no recycle: about 44.5 MMSCFD at 130 MMSCFD H2, about 782 short ton/d uncaptured at 90%
Hold 34.0 MMSCFD without recycle: about 99 MMSCFD H2

decisions.question: Which reference case and reactor rating should the project use?
decisions.why: Reactor capital, process heat, and the claim of no fired stage all change. Report and deck currently disagree on 210 and 230 MWth.
decisions.default: Stay on Case 6 with 230 MWth as in the 31 October draft, since it needs the fewest changes before 15 November. Show Case 5 as the alternative.
options: Case 6 at 210 MWth with 4.1 MWe import
Case 5 at 210 MWth: 875 C, 850 C He, 34.5 MMSCFD, fired Stage 2 kept

decisions.question: Which CO2 basis applies for 90% capture?
decisions.why: It moves captured CO2 by about 31,000 t/y and emitted CO2 from 207 to 317 short ton/d.
decisions.default: Apply 90% per pass to 1,946 short ton/d syngas CO2, giving 1,752 captured, unless a recycle loop is modelled.
options: Model the recycle loop for overall capture

decisions.question: Where does MEA reboiler heat come from?
decisions.why: Recoverable heat is about 55 MWth against 76 to 79 MWth, and the 230 MWth draft leaves only 9.6 MWth unallocated. Burning PSA reject would cover it but undoes the 34.0 MMSCFD basis.
decisions.default: Use freed Selexol LP steam and export steam first, claim no export steam credit, and state the 21 to 24 MWth shortfall as an added load until resolved.
options: Steam plus dropping or changing ZLD
Burn part of PSA reject and accept higher gas use

decisions.question: Which absorber feed conditions should the MEA simulation use?
decisions.why: CO2 partial pressure differs by about 25 to 35% and affects solvent rate and reboiler duty.
decisions.default: Use the INL flowsheet values: 40 C, 26.8 bar, about 18 mol% CO2.
options: amine_spec 35 C and 21 bar with a stated reason
INL pressure with extra cooling to 35 C

decisions.question: Which power conversion efficiency applies?
decisions.why: Complete Case 6 sizing is 220.4 MWth at 39.7% and 213.2 MWth at 47.5%.
decisions.default: Use 39.7% as central, with 47.5% as a labelled sensitivity.

gaps: Not verified: Case 6 calculator and Aspen sheets (A-60 onward) are absent; the local TEV-961 PDF ends at A-59 (PDF p83). Whether the public file has them was not checked, because nothing was downloaded.
Electronic stream appendices (TEV-953 B to E, TEV-961 B to G) are not local, so no per-stream composition exists for any case.
Not verified: the breakdown of 5.7 MWe between recycle compression and cryogenic duty. The term Purge Recovery is never defined in text.
Not verified: Case 6 recycle flow, composition, cryogenic splits, H2 returned to PSA, and N2-rich gas flow.
Not verified: Case 6 reformer inlet temperature and pressure, S/C (3.0 is assumed by drafts), methane conversion, WGS conditions, and absorber CO2 fraction (my rough estimate is 17 to 19 mol%).
Not verified: Case 6 Selexol steam, exchanger duties and water breakdown. Case 5 is the closest published proxy.
TEV-981, the source of 39.7%, is not local.
INL's 17.3 MWe list has no secondary helium circulator. Labels imply a 60 psi loop drop and about 7.6 MW ideal gas work (my calculation on nominal pressure drops), and no INL value exists.
MEA pump and blower loads are not in 17.3 MWe, and IHX or loop heat losses are not in 176.8 MWth.
Unmodelled: 90% MEA gives about 10 times INL's CO2 slip, which would enter a cryogenic unit and the reformer if recycle is kept. 34.0 MMSCFD may not transfer to MEA.
INL did not evaluate the fuel gas purge option or any no-recycle 900 C case; my no-recycle rows are screening estimates, not simulations.
'Case A' is undefined in the task. The repo E2 file uses it for IEAGHG unabated SMR, so I answered for INL Case 6 and listed the complete conventional cases.
